arrays.description: a sequence of arrays to concatenate; each must have the same shape except along the specified axis. If a single array is given it will be treated equivalently to `arrays = unstack(arrays)`, but the implementation will avoid explicit unstacking.
constraints: all arrays in arrays must have the same shape except along the specified axis
if arrays contains only one array, it will still be treated as a sequence of arrays

axis.description: specify the axis along which to concatenate. If None, the arrays are flattened before concatenation.
constraints: all arrays in arrays must have the same shape except along the specified axis

dtype.description: optional dtype of the resulting array. If not specified, the dtype will be determined via type promotion rules described in :ref:`type-promotion`.
constraints: must be a valid numpy dtype
all arrays in arrays must have the same shape except along the specified axis
